outcome_evidence: In base_image, the robot separates the initially nested cups (frames 64–74 and 142–145), then places a cup above the two lower cups to form a small stack (frames 175–193). It subsequently gathers the cups back into a compact nested stack (frames 226–268 and 275–300). The released stack remains stable on the table with both grippers withdrawn through frame 322. “Pack” is interpreted as nesting the cups together; no separate packing container is visible. No failed acquisition, toppling, or harmful side effect is observed.
